usages.explain: Used when talking about an organization, expressing that it is a unified entity formed under the leadership of a certain representative.

examples.content: 弊社では、社長以下約200人が全員一丸となって働いています。
examples.transcription: へいしゃでは、しゃちょういかやく200にんがぜんいんいちがんとなってはたらいています。
examples.mean: At our company, about 200 people work together, including the president.

examples.content: キャプテン鈴木以下25名、全員そろいました。
examples.transcription: きゃぷてんすずきいか25めい、ぜんいんそろいました。
examples.mean: All 25 people, including Captain Suzuki, were there.

title: ... いか + từ chỉ số lượng => How many ... under the leadership, under the authority of ...
